title: Design
description: Output of Phase 2.5 (architectural tier only). The judge synthesizes the winning sketch from the two independent design sketches and grafts the best of the runner-up. Phase 3 Dev implements THIS, not just the spec.

issue_number.description: Tracker issue number. Accepts a string for an experiment run (/pipeline --dry-run), which uses an exp-<slug> placeholder instead of opening a tracker issue, and null before an id exists.

summary.description: The end-to-end approach: data model, contract changes, control flow, failure modes, migration shape.

migration_shape.description: The up and down of any schema migration, if the project uses migrations (down documented as manual-rollback notes, not executable).

grafted_from_runner_up.description: Elements taken from the losing sketch and why they strengthen the winner.

experiment_id.description: Present only on an experiment run: the exp-<slug> placeholder id used in place of a tracker issue.
